chunks.subject: AP Microeconomics
chunks.title: Q1 Long FRQ (10 points) — Set 1: monopoly (Voda Reservoir) & elasticity
chunks.content: AP Microeconomics FRQ 1 (Long), 10 points, one point per element, mixing correctly labeled graphs with state/explain and calculation answers. Set 1 (Voda Reservoir, a single seller of bottled water): draw a correctly labeled monopoly graph with a downward-sloping demand and MR, showing the profit-maximizing quantity/price (MR=MC) and the relevant area; state how the profit-maximizing quantity changes under a given scenario; state that demand for Voda's water becomes more elastic (with a substitute) and explain why; plus related state/explain elements. Common failure: unlabeled or incorrectly positioned MR/MC/ATC curves; profit-max where MR≠MC; stating an elasticity change without explaining the substitute mechanism.
